boards.name: 01 Typography / Philosophy
boards.purpose: Establish productive enterprise tone, AI-content requirements, density boundaries, localization, and brand-expression limits.

boards.name: 02 Typography / Font family candidates
boards.purpose: Compare unapproved primary and monospace candidates without selecting a winner.

boards.name: 03 Typography / Font delivery and licensing
boards.purpose: Make every delivery, licensing, version, redistribution, and ownership decision visible.

boards.name: 04 Typography / Type scale anatomy
boards.purpose: Explain existing primitive stops and role-led size, line-height, and tracking relationships without approving values.

boards.name: 05 Typography / Display styles
boards.purpose: Compare rare display candidates across contexts, content lengths, and fallbacks.

boards.name: 06 Typography / Heading styles
boards.purpose: Demonstrate page and section hierarchy, adjacent-level differentiation, and multiline behavior.

boards.name: 07 Typography / Body styles
boards.purpose: Compare reading hypotheses with measure, paragraphs, lists, links, and emphasis.

boards.name: 08 Typography / Labels and captions
boards.purpose: Test concise supporting roles with wrapping, translation expansion, and sentence case.

boards.name: 09 Typography / Numeric and data typography
boards.purpose: Treat metrics, tables, dates, currency, and localized numerals as first-class typography.

boards.name: 10 Typography / Code typography
boards.purpose: Evaluate code readability, ambiguous glyphs, indentation, overflow, and ligatures.

boards.name: 11 Typography / Responsive typography
boards.purpose: Compare compact, medium, and expanded contexts without approving fixed or fluid behavior.

boards.name: 12 Typography / Dense enterprise typography
boards.purpose: Stress typography for tables, filters, logs, dashboards, and monitoring without creating components.

boards.name: 13 Typography / Internationalization
boards.purpose: Test expansion, direction, scripts, combining marks, identifiers, and locale-specific formatting.

boards.name: 14 Typography / Accessibility
boards.purpose: Record contrast, resize, reflow, text-spacing, hierarchy, non-color, and truncation obligations.

boards.name: 15 Typography / Light and Dark examples
boards.purpose: Show identical typography against approved theme roles without adding typography modes.

boards.name: 16 Typography / Decision log
boards.purpose: Record decisions, alternatives, rationale, owners, dates, and supersession links.

boards.name: 17 Typography / Review and approval
boards.purpose: Keep design, engineering, accessibility, licensing, governance, and release dispositions separate.

boards.name: 18 Typography / Handoff and evidence
boards.purpose: Map approved Figma representations to sources, generated outputs, IDs, captures, and drift evidence.
